name: info: Show Capturing Progression Guide
description: Shows a guide to vanilla capturing ship progression, from smallest to biggest capturable ship.

values: Shows a guide to vanilla capturing ship progression, from smallest to biggest capturable ship.

children.key: * "Bunkmax" means, you sell every outfit that is not needed, replace needed outfits by weaker ones, buy outfit expansion till you have no cargo or overheat, and install as many Bunk Rooms as possible. This means also no weapons.
* The bunkmax number can be a little bit higher if you invest time and money to find the perfect outfits.
* Your fleet should be equipped with beam weapons, to not destroy the target.
* You can skip many ships in this list, based on your choice and luck.

* Start with 'Laser Rifle' hand-to-hand outfits, better get 'Fragmentation Grenade', and when reaching Korath ships do the Heliarch/Lunarium storyline to get the 'Enforcer Riot Gear'/'Anti-Materiel Gun'.

name: info: Show City Ship License Guide
description: Shows a guide for the City Ship License, which is needed to purchase a Bactrian.

values: Shows a guide for the City Ship License, which is needed to purchase a Bactrian.

children.key: The "City Ship License" missions are only doable before joining the Free Worlds or after completing the Free Worlds campaign, NOT during!
do at least one of these 3 deep escort missions:
do 3x "Mystery Cube Delivery" or "Mystery Cube Retrieval "
(3 mystery cube missions, combat rating 100, at least 1 escort)
Reward is the City Ship License, which allows you to buy a Bactrian.

name: info: Show Emerald Sword Guide
description: Shows a guide for obtaining the Emerald Sword.

values: Shows a guide for obtaining the Emerald Sword.

children.key: The Emerald Sword is mighty unique heavy warship obtainable by a long mission chain. A completed Free Worlds campaign is needed from the middle of this chain.
Travel to Midgard and take some samples.
Travel to Midgard, there is an anomaly.
Return to Vinci, evade following ships.
"There Might Be Riots 1" > "Transport band to Wayfarer"
"There Might Be Riots 2" > "Transport band to Prime"
(needs Deep Archeology 5 | in Syndicate space | 30% chance | 4 cargo |
"There Might Be Riots part 3A" > "Transport band to Pilot"
(needs first contact Hai | from dirt belt, south, rim | 30% chance | 4 cargo |
"There Might Be Riots part 3B" > "Transport band to Allhome"
Fly to Ildaria and wait a few minutes till a conversation pops up,
(from Asgard | evade the ship that is following | 17 cargo)
(near "Zubeneschamali" 1-100 | needs first contact Hai Unfettered, needs Free
Contact the information dealer on Stormhold.
"Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 4" > "The Search for the Artifact"
"Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 5" > "The Fight for the Artifact"
Ask the Hai about the box at Allhome.
"Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 7a" > "The Museum of Galactic History"
"Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 7b" > "The Hai Ministry of Culture"
"Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 1" > "Black Box Decoded"
"Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 2" > "The Emerald Sword"
Bring a jump drive to Zug.
"Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3" > "The Emerald Sword"
Search for the ship in the newly discovered system.
(from Valley of the Damned | 25 cargo | 150 passengers)
Congratulations! Now you are the proud owner of this unique and mighty ship!
